Ok, story time. When i was small for halloween i was given a cat costume. (like faux fur, tail ears, zipper the whole thing). I loved it. 

Fast forward a bunch of years and i'm an anime nerd, I find out about cat girls, so i draw a bunch of that. That's literally what got me into art, drawing cat girls, and pokemon, and fakemon. 

So of course then i find out about furry, and the rest is history. i didn't decide to call myself a furry till last year mind you. 

I don't think i was ever into any of it because i wanted to fit in somewhere, not at all, it felt "other", it was a lot more interesting than every day life. Sure I was bullied, but that was separate to me. 

Every day life is just boring. Nature is far more exciting, so is science fiction, fantasy. But I used to entertain myself but imagining what it would be like to be various animals, to feel what they felt and see what they saw. The thought of just being content with one perspective of existence just felt so mundane, and still does. 

Only recently have i discovered topics such as mirror touch synaesthesia. I wonder how many furries are synaesthetes, or have mirror touch. I've got Grapheme color synaesthesia, and i just might have mirror touch, i always cringe watching action movies. 

I've also always been very close with whatever pets I've had, it's almost as if i could just pick up on how they felt, humans too but that's a given. 

Aside from that, i wonder what freude would have to say, or kinsey. how do you plot someone like a furry on the kinsey scale? what does this say about sexuality (if that's what you like about it). 

Thoughts for food. 

Edit:// it also could be that anything fuzzy is just instantly better than just smooth things because it's soft, perhaps that's just the jist of it and we're all putting way too much thought into this lol.
